title: Analysis code and derived results for: Is Genetically Proxied Anxiety a Causal Risk Factor for Chronic Neck-Shoulder Pain? A Two-Sample Mendelian Randomization Study

creators.name: Dong, Jige
creators.affiliation: aSSIST University, 46, Ewhayeodae 2-gil, Seodaemun-gu, Seoul, 03767, Republic of Korea

creators.name: Huang, Minghao
creators.affiliation: aSSIST University, 46, Ewhayeodae 2-gil, Seodaemun-gu, Seoul, 03767, Republic of Korea

description: Analysis code (R/Python) and derived result tables for a two-sample Mendelian randomization study of genetically proxied anxiety-related presentation (GP-ANXD) and chronic neck-shoulder pain, including cross-design replication using FinnGen R12 outcomes. Input data are publicly available GWAS summary statistics from IEU OpenGWAS and the FinnGen public release; no individual-level data were used.
